day5_morning_plan_escape.text: *Last night, the plan was escape. First, getting out alive. Evidence could wait.*

day5_morning_plan_expose.text: *Last night, I decided to expose everything. Get out alive and take the records too. I'm not letting go of either.*

day5_morning_plan_confront.text: *Last night, I chose confrontation. I decided to put the records in front of Eunsu.*

day5_morning_dawn_1.text: *4 AM. I couldn’t sleep, and I’m done lying here.*

day5_morning_dawn_2.text: *I check the clock in the darkness. The fluorescent hands tremble. — No, it's my hands that are trembling.*

day5_morning_dawn_3.text:
*Inside my bag: handwritten notes, my phone, and the documents I recovered. Battery: 68%.*

*A Student Safety app notification hovers over the lock screen.*

*`Attendance scheduled 08:10`*

*It blinks once.*

*`Collection scheduled 23:00`*

*I turn off the screen.*

day5_morning_dawn_4.text:
*I take out my notebook. The operation I wrote down last night. My handwriting shakes so badly half of it is hard to read. At the very bottom, there is one sentence that does not look like something I wrote.*

*`Second staircase. Do not run.`*

*The pen marks are deep enough to tear the paper.*

day5_morning_dawn_5.text: *I tied my sneakers tight. I might have to run.*

day5_morning_dawn_6.text: *I stood at the door. Paused for a moment.*

day5_morning_dawn_7.text: *Beyond the door is the hallway at four in the morning. No fluorescent hum. No refrigerator next door.*

day5_morning_dawn_8.text: *I held my breath and opened the door. The hallway. Only the green glow of emergency lights. No one's here.*

day5_morning_dawn_9.text: *No one is there. And yet, under the emergency light, only the CCTV lens slowly turns toward me.*

day5_morning_dawn_10.text: *I go quietly down the stairs. Beneath the orange streetlights there are no people or cars, only the wind.*

day5_morning_dawn_11.text:
*Only my footsteps were left on the dawn street.*

*My phone turns back on. For 0.2 seconds, the name on the lock screen changes.*

*`S-13`*

*Then `{name}` again.*

day5_morning_dawn_12.text:
*Twenty minutes to school. Only my footsteps echo on the predawn road.*

*Every clue meets beneath the old building. I have to check the basement first.*

day5_morning_school_1.text: *The school came into view. In the dark, only the outline of the building showed. The usual windows were all shut black.*

day5_morning_school_2.text: *The front gate is open. The lock lies on the ground, its shackle undone and swinging.*

day5_morning_school_3.text: *The iron gate sways slightly in the wind, half-open. Creak, creak. The sound amplifies in my ears.*

day5_morning_school_4.text: *The entry terminal beside the front gate is on. No one has touched it, but the light turns green.*

day5_morning_school_6.text: *The terminal screen goes dark. My face appears in the glass, but the letters on my name tag come into focus first.*

day5_morning_school_7.text: *The Student Safety app vibrates. There is no notification—only three pulses: short, long, short.*

day5_morning_school_8.text: *I cross the sandy field and slow down in front of the main building. My feet already point toward the old wing.*

day5_morning_school_9.text: *The entrance to the old wing. The door is open. Inside is pitch black. I turned on my phone flashlight. The beam swept across the hallway.*

day5_morning_school_10.text: *Letters are scratched into the wall. Graffiti? No. Fingernail marks. Even though I can't read them, my fingertips follow the strokes.*

day5_morning_school_11.text: *The stairs lead down to the basement. The concrete is cold beneath every step. Somewhere, a pipe knocks at regular intervals. Thump, thump, thump.*

day5_morning_rescue_1.text: *The phone light swept across the basement. Pipes, filing cabinets, old medical equipment. — And a bed in the corner.*

day5_morning_rescue_2.text:
*Yuna is tied to the bed. Her eyes are open, but her focus wavers. The leather straps around her wrists have rubbed her skin red.*

Yuna, I'm here. I'll undo the straps first.

day5_morning_rescue_2_unknown.text:
*An unfamiliar girl is tied to the bed. Her eyes are open, but her focus wavers. The leather straps around her wrists have rubbed her skin red.*

Are you okay? I'll undo the straps first.

day5_morning_rescue_3_unknown.text: Who's there? Are you a student?

day5_morning_rescue_4_unknown.text:
*On the floor beside the bed lies a bag with a photography club tag. I reach for the leather straps first.*

Save your breath for later. Relax your wrists.

day5_morning_rescue_5_unknown.text: I'm Choi Yuna. Photography club. Please grab my camera from under the bed first.

day5_morning_rescue_4.text:
*Yuna’s eyes refocus. She gasps for breath and opens her mouth.*

Can you hear me? I'll undo the straps. Where does it hurt most?

day5_morning_rescue_5.text: Sunbae. Look at the record for number seven.

day5_morning_rescue_5a.text:
*Her trembling finger points toward the pile of papers scattered across the floor.*

That pile of documents? Don't move.

day5_morning_rescue_6.text: Okay. Please untie the straps first.

day5_morning_rescue_7.text:
*I yank at the tight leather knot until the tips of my nails scrape raw, finally working it loose. Her bound wrists and my own hands are equally cold.*

There. Try moving your hands. Tell me if it hurts.

day5_morning_rescue_8.text: The first was number eight. Back then, I thought he was just a sunbae I didn't know.

day5_morning_rescue_9.text: The eighth sunbae asked me to take his picture. He said, 'Leave a record of who I was.'

day5_morning_rescue_10.text: ...Back then the name was 'Choi Siwoo.' Quiet, always sitting in the corner of the library.

day5_morning_rescue_11.text: That day, I couldn't let go of the camera strap. Their eyes were red and blurred.

day5_morning_rescue_12.text: I didn't understand then. I only remember the hand holding the camera.

day5_morning_rescue_13.text: A few months later, the same face arrived with a different name tag. He didn't recognize me.

day5_morning_rescue_14.text:
*Yuna's lips tremble.*

So I didn't recognize you. I showed up again with nothing changed except my name tag.

day5_morning_rescue_15.text: From then on, I pressed the shutter every time the name tag changed.

day5_morning_rescue_16.text: The 9th file is disconnected on the third night. The name tag was ‘Han Ji-ho’.

day5_morning_rescue_17.text: The name changed, but the request was always the same: 'Record me.' His hand always reached for the camera.

day5_morning_rescue_18.text: The folders cover three years. One face, more and more name tags.

day5_morning_rescue_19.text:
*Moisture gathers in Yuna's eyes but doesn't fall.*

You kept all those photos? All on your own?

day5_morning_rescue_20.text: My hands shook every time. But I couldn't put down the camera.

day5_morning_rescue_21.text:
*The camera strap marks Yuna's wrist red.*

Let's just loosen the strap a little. I'm not taking your camera.

day5_morning_rescue_22.text:
*I help Yuna up to her feet. Her legs give way and she stumbles, so I pull her arm across my shoulder.*

Lean on me. Don't walk on your own. Falling will only slow us down.

day5_morning_escape_end.text: *I grabbed Yuna's arm and headed up the stairs. Getting out comes first.*

day5_morning_true_1.text: *I searched through the documents. I found them where Yuna had pointed.*

day5_morning_true_2.text:
*#7. The photo shows a long-haired boy named Kim Taeho. His cheeks are hollow and his cheekbones stand out. Even the angle of his eyes is mine.*

Me again. Yuna, why does this number matter?

day5_morning_true_3.text:
*The remarks section for #7 is long. Red stamps overlap each other.*

*`S-07 / external contact / companion: Lee Seolhwa / result: subject secured`*

*The line beneath it has been crossed out twice in black pen.*

*`S-07 -> S-08`*

day5_morning_true_4.text: ...Lee Seolhwa... the girl you talk to in the hallway... she's in here...

day5_morning_true_5.text:
*Yuna parts her lips, then readjusts her grip on the camera without a word.*

Seolhwa is in the records? Not just someone else with the same name?

day5_morning_true_6.text:
*More papers lie scattered on the floor. There is no time to read them, so I photograph whatever I can see with my phone.*

No time to read everything. Let’s take photos first.

day5_morning_true_7.text: Sunbae, that over there looks like Ms. Eunsu’s journal.

day5_morning_true_8.text:
*Sitting propped against the bed, Yuna points to another stack of papers. It is Ms. Eunsu’s observation log, filled with neat handwriting.*

I'll photograph that too. Open it so the writing's clear.

day5_morning_true_9.text: ***'Trial #7 Remarks: Drug resistance reaction. External contact confirmed with facility student Lee Seolhwa (female, 17). Result: subject secured. Lee Seolhwa — unmodifiable. S-07 — re-registered as S-08.'***

day5_morning_true_10.text: *...Lee Seolhwa. There is a small photo pasted beside the name. That face from the back seat of the classroom. Under the photo, an arrow has been drawn in what looks like my handwriting.*

day5_morning_true_11.text: *Processing time 23:02. S-07 re-registration time 23:11. The two times are attached to the same line.*

day5_morning_true_12.text: *A stamp marks the corner of the document. `Discarded`. The ink has run, seeping into the grain of the desk.*

day5_morning_true_13.text: *My phone camera focuses automatically. A photograph of Lee Seolhwa. The empty space beside it. Only the spot I had always seen is blank white.*

day5_morning_true_14.text: ***'After Trial #8: Subject converses with blank point. Repeats "Lee Seolhwa". Companion response has calming effect. Reevaluate dosage.'***

day5_morning_true_15.text:
*In the same neat strokes she used on the blackboard during class, a note reads: `Drug dosage needs review`.*

This is Ms. Eunsu's handwriting.

day5_morning_true_16.text: ***'Trials #9-#12: Same phenomenon. No matching student in camera/entry/seat records. Subject leaves the same seat empty.'***

day5_morning_true_17.text: ***'Addendum: Acute anxiety when blank seat is removed. Leave undisturbed at this stage.'***

day5_morning_true_18.text: *`Blank seat`. `Calming effect`. `Left undisturbed`. I try to photograph the three phrases, yet the camera keeps losing focus.*

day5_morning_true_19.text:
*The name label in the dialogue window blinked once.*

*`Seolhwa`*

*`Blank`*

*Then `Seolhwa` again.*

day5_morning_true_20.text:
*The seat at the back of the classroom, the end of the corridor, in front of the closed door. The records are blank for every place where I saw Seolhwa.*

I know I saw her. Are you saying no one else could?

day5_morning_true_21.text: That seat is empty in every photo. I can't photograph what you see.

day5_morning_true_22.text: *The last page of the observation log. The date was two days ago.*

day5_morning_true_23.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 2: Unauthorized contact with Choi Yuna. Risk of copy leakage. Recommend isolation.'***

day5_morning_true_24.text: ***'Trial #13 Day 3: Choi Yuna isolation complete. Separate copy confirmed. Report on hold.'***

day5_morning_true_25.text:
*Even the date Yuna and I checked the photos is logged in the journal.*

They were recording everything from that day on. How did they even know about photos only the two of us saw?

day5_morning_true_26.text:
*The journal says 'isolation'; attendance, last night's 'transfer'.*

They tied you here and called it a transfer. Same person, different records.

day5_morning_true_27.text: *In the photo, Lee Seolhwa's last recorded date is one year ago. From the next page on, only my face continues, under different names.*

day5_morning_true_28.text:
*The red marks on Yuna's wrist brush the paper edges.*

Your wrist hurts, right? We'll leave once I get these. Hold on a little longer.

day5_morning_true_29.text: We have to get out of here. They'll be here soon.

day5_morning_true_30.text: Sunbae... Nurse Riin will be down soon. She always comes to give the medicine.

day5_morning_true_31.text:
*Yuna grabs me, but her fingers soon slip off.*

Okay. They're coming soon, right? I won't keep reading.

day5_morning_true_32.text: ...Sunbae. It's all in this camera. Three years of... who you were.

day5_morning_true_33.text: If we get out of here... you have to take this with you...

day5_morning_true_34.text:
*I take Yuna's cold hand.*

Keep the camera. I'll photograph the papers. You take care of that.

day5_morning_true_35.text: *I photograph everything: Edina Foundation logo, Nevergrad final report, returns table beneath the cover.*

day5_morning_true_36.text: *Identity Package Change Protocol. Parents, hometown, previous school, friends’ names. Each field has an effective date and a verification mark.*

day5_morning_true_37.text: *Board approval document. Commercialization proposal. A note beside the expected return: `After S-13 stabilization data is secured`.*

day5_morning_true_38.text: *Last page. 'Trial #13: Blank-seat response persists. Repeats Lee Seolhwa designation. Residual memory threshold exceeded. Review early processing.'*

day5_morning_true_39.text: *`Review for early processing.` The camera's focus trembles over the line.*

day5_morning_true_timer_choice.text: *No matter what choice I make — there's no time.*

day5_morning_true_run_1.text:
*I pack the evidence and take Yuna's arm.*

Let's go. Hold on to me and follow.

day5_morning_true_hide_1.text: *I hid in the shadows behind the filing cabinets. I put a finger to my lips, trying to keep Yuna's trembling breaths from being heard. Footsteps passed by on the stairs above.*

day5_morning_true_hide_2.text: *Holding my breath won't change anything. I have to move now.*

day5_morning_true_exit_1.text: *As I climbed the stairs — Ms. Eunsu stood there, blocking the hallway towards the old building's exit.*

day5_morning_true_exit_2.text: {name}... Where did you get that camera?

day5_morning_true_ft.text: *The teacher smiles without delaying even a beat. Yuna holds the camera hidden in the palm of her hand.*
choices: Move. I know what I saw in the basement.
We got lost. We're leaving now.
Yuna feels dizzy. I'm taking her to the nurse's office.

day5_morning_true_ft_confront.text: ...{name}, that's not something to discuss in the hallway. Put the camera down and come with me.

day5_morning_true_ft_lost.text: It's all right. You're not hurt, are you? I'll walk you out. Come this way.

day5_morning_true_ft_yuna.text: All right. The nurse's office is on the 1st floor of the main building, isn't it? Let's go together. I'll help support her.

day5_morning_true_ft_stall.text: Hold on. Slow down. — Hear the teacher out before you go, hm?

day5_morning_true_post_ft_1.text:
*A hand settles on my shoulder. It is warm. Little by little, the fingertips dig in.*

Let go. I'm not hurt. I'm not going with you.

day5_morning_true_post_ft_2.text: *Ms. Eunsu didn't grab me right away. The instant her gaze flicked toward the ceiling, a heavy iron door slammed shut somewhere upstairs.*

day5_morning_true_post_ft_3.text: *Eunsu's gaze moves from the camera to the bag, then toward the old-wing stairs. I take Yuna's wrist and slip past her.*

day5_morning_blockade_1.text:
*An iron locking bar blocks the door at the end of the corridor. That door was open until yesterday. The bar wasn’t there then.*

Yuna, this way's blocked. Back we go. It wasn't here yesterday.

day5_morning_blockade_2.text:
*We make it all the way to the far end of the opposite corridor, only to find the same thing. Rattling the handle, Yuna looks back.*

This one's locked too. Sunbae, we can't get out this way either.

day5_morning_blockade_4.text: *Yuna and I meet eyes. She pulls the camera against her chest, and I adjust my grip on my bag strap.*

day5_morning_blockade_5.text: *Ksshht— Static burst from the speakers. Then underneath it, a sound. A music box. A slow, off-key music box melody, like a warped graduation song.*

day5_morning_broadcast_2.text: *Her voice flows from the speakers, no different from any ordinary day. Running the tip of my tongue across my upper teeth leaves a taste of iron.*

day5_morning_broadcast_3.text: Today is a special day. We have a **graduation ceremony**.

day5_morning_broadcast_4.text:
*The graduation announcement ends, leaving static.*

What kind of graduation ceremony locks every corridor?

day5_morning_broadcast_5.text: {name}. Would you come to the classroom?

day5_morning_broadcast_7.text: *The music box played one more measure — then cut off. The broadcast ended. Silence.*

day5_morning_broadcast_9.text:
*Yuna's voice trembles. Her grip tightens on my sleeve.*

We're not going into the classroom.

day5_morning_broadcast_10.text: Let's head upstairs. First let's see if any doors on the upper floors of the old wing are still unlocked.

day5_morning_broadcast_11.text: There's an emergency exit on the third floor. If we can just get there—

day5_morning_broadcast_12.text:
*Clang. On the stairs overhead, a heavy iron door slams shut.*

Hold on—stop.

day5_morning_broadcast_13.text:
*We both look up. Clang. Another iron door slams shut, echoing down the stairwell.*

That's the 3rd floor. Are they locking down the emergency exits too?

day5_morning_broadcast_15.text:
*Her knuckles turn white around my sleeve.*

What if it's blocked upstairs too? Is it safe to keep going up?

day5_morning_broadcast_16.text: Go up. There's still one door we haven't checked.

day5_morning_broadcast_17.text:
*Her grip tightens again.*

Lead on. Don't let go. Don't stop just because it's blocked. I'll follow.

day5_morning_broadcast_18.text: *Only the classroom door is open. Every other door is locked. There's only one way to go.*

day5_morning_grad_1.text: ...I'll wait outside. If I go in — they'll catch me too.

day5_morning_grad_3.text: As soon as you come out, run.

day5_morning_grad_4.text:
*Slipping into the shadow at the corner of the hall, she checks my phone screen.*

You started the recording, right? While you're talking inside, I'll keep watch outside the door.

day5_morning_grad_6.text: *No one is here. 30 empty desks. Every chair faces the blackboard. Rows and spacing aligned as if measured with a ruler.*

day5_morning_grad_7.text: *On each desk, a name tag. Numbers 1 through 12. Cycle numbers and the names assigned then. — Seat 13 is empty. My seat.*

day5_morning_grad_8.text: *Written on the blackboard: 'Congratulations on Your Graduation — 13th'*

day5_morning_grad_9.text: *White chalk dust still lies beneath the neat writing. The careful strokes are Eunsu's, just as in class.*

day5_morning_grad_10.text:
*On the lectern lie 13 sheets clipped together. Every single photo attached is of my face—only the names change.*

Only the names are different. Every photo is me.

day5_morning_grad_12.text:
*When I turn around, Ms. Eunsu walks up to the lectern and lifts the stack of documents.*

If my face is on those papers, don't cover them—let me see.

day5_morning_grad_13.text: It's your diploma. In your name.

day5_morning_grad_14.text:
*The paper bears 13 names, from Kim Dojin to '{name}'. The title reads 'Processing Completion Certificate'. It has been stamped twelve times; the last box has no stamp ink.*

You called it a diploma. Why that title? Why is my space blank?

day5_morning_grad_15.text: *Ms. Eunsu turns the first sheet. Kim Dojin. Beside the photo runs a line written in red ink.*

day5_morning_grad_16.text: ***'Day 3 22:14. Attempted to leave through the front gate. Recovered.'***

day5_morning_grad_17.text:
*The second page. Lee Junseo. There is a small stain on the corner of the paper. I can't tell whether it's coffee or water.*

I've never seen that name before, but that's my face.

day5_morning_grad_18.text:
*The fifth page. Kang Minhyuk. The attached memo reads, 'Increased time spent in faculty office. Dependency response favorable.'*

You even wrote down my visits to you as a dependency response.

day5_morning_grad_19.text:
*The sixth page. Jeong Hayul. A black clip over the photo. Beside it, a photo of a drug vial is attached.*

You even attached a photo of the medicine bottle.

day5_morning_grad_20.text:
*On the seventh page, Ms. Eunsu's hand stops. Kim Taeho. Another photo is half tucked behind his. A dark-brown-haired schoolgirl. Her face has been deliberately cropped out.*

Show me the photo tucked behind it too. Why did you cut out the face?

day5_morning_grad_21.text:
*Instead of answering, she presses a finger over the corner of the photo to hide it.*

Why are you covering it? Who is that girl?

day5_morning_grad_21a.text:
*The lectern drawer is half open. I can see a letter inside. 'Thanks to you, I had a wonderful school life.' The name is Song Yejun. The date is the night of Day 5 in the 10th cycle.*

So even at the end, I wrote to thank you, and then I was erased.

day5_morning_grad_23.text:
*Picks up chopsticks with the left hand. Skips the third step on the stairs. Props the right cheek on a hand when looking out the window. Shakes chocolate milk twice.*

You wrote down everything, even how I sit and what I drink.

day5_morning_grad_24.text: Did you confirm I was the same person just from my habits?

day5_morning_grad_25.text: Even when memories are erased, habits remain.

day5_morning_grad_26.text:
*Eunsu's smile quickly fades.*

Don't smile. I didn't ask to have my memory erased.

day5_morning_grad_27.text:
*The words stop. The items on the checklist come into focus, line by line.*

If the habits stayed, you knew I was the same person. Only the name changed.

day5_morning_grad_29.text:
*Ms. Eunsu starts to call my name, then stops and looks at the checklist again.*

When you say my name, look at me in front of you, not at the paper.

day5_morning_grad_29a.text:
*The gentle look she wears in class is gone. Only the fingertips holding the pages tremble ever so slightly.*

The name you just called me—did you pick that off this list too?

day5_morning_grad_30.text: ...If you have questions, ask them now.

choices: "You wrote all that down and kept watching me?"

day5_morning_grad_reply_1b.text: Right. That's what the first page says. I hid behind it for a while too.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2.text: ...The first approval only had the board seal. My name wasn't there.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2b.text:
*She puts a finger on the third sheet. It is stamped 'Request for Extension Approval'. Applicant: Park Eunsu.*

That's your name on it, not the board's.

day5_morning_grad_reply_2c.text: ...From here on, it has my signature.

day5_morning_grad_reply_3.text:
*Ms. Eunsu smiles, but her eyes stay fixed on the checklist.*

I have something to say. Put that paper down first.

day5_morning_proposal_1.text: *The words run out. Only the two of us remain in the classroom.*

day5_morning_proposal_2.text:
*Ms. Eunsu walks around the lectern toward me, then stops 2 meters away.*

Don't come any closer. Say it from there.

day5_morning_proposal_3.text:
Don't pretend you didn't hear me. Answer me all the way through.

*Ms. Eunsu's lips parted slightly, yet no sound came out.*

day5_morning_proposal_5.text:
*She kneels before the lectern.*

Stand up and talk. Kneeling won't change anything.

day5_morning_proposal_6.text: I know it's not something that can be erased with an apology.

day5_morning_proposal_7.text:
*She doesn't look at the approvals bearing her name.*

Your name is on those papers. What does apologizing to me do about that?

day5_morning_proposal_8.text:
*She raises her head, eyes red.*

Don't just say you're sorry. Tell me what you're going to do now.

day5_morning_proposal_9.text: When you’re here, the numbers stabilize. I used that as an excuse to keep you here.

day5_morning_proposal_10.text:
*She stands without wiping her eyes.*

Not the numbers. What about me wanting to leave? Was that missing from the records?

day5_morning_proposal_13.text: One. Stay here. I'll leave your place as it is. I won't erase your memories.

day5_morning_proposal_14.text: Two. Erase it. The pain, the body trying to run, all of it quiets down. We can start over next Monday.

day5_morning_proposal_16.text:
*She shuts her mouth.*

Why leave out the way to get outside?

day5_morning_proposal_17.text: I'd rather there wasn't a third choice.

day5_morning_end_cage.text: *My feet stop. I sit in the chair. Ms. Eunsu smiles.*

day5_morning_end_forget.text: *...I closed my eyes. Ms. Eunsu's hand touches my forehead. It's cold.*

day5_morning_end_run.text: *I turn and run toward the stairs.*

day5_morning_complicit_call.text: *My phone rings. Ms. Eunsu’s name is on the screen.*

day5_morning_complicit_offer.text: Come to the faculty office today. Take care of the next student. I’ll move your record.

day5_morning_complicit_accept.text: *I pull the document envelope I had packed out of my bag and set it down on the desk. To reach the faculty office, all I have to do is walk to school through the main gate.*
